Every adapted hanger mounting point reaches a curved internal support beam
Existing stairs staff-room side routes and covered end passage remain clear

Each interlevel assembly joins a real lower-roof bearing cabinet riser and upper portal
Interlevel equipment and supports avoid the actual overhead-line meshes

limits: An interpretation of the supplied aerial photograph. Roof dimensions and internal support arrangements are model adaptations, not measured engineering data. Original wire, insulator, mast and lower hanger coordinates stay; only upper hanger ends and mounting plates adapt to the curved support beams. No inherited positions are claimed to be surveyed.
